purpose: Keep TellMeN0TE, ChatGPT, N0TE, the external cloud coordination plane, local execution, and temporary N0TE construction machinery semantically separate while allowing them to cooperate through shared state and receipts.

layers.purpose: Human artist/principal. Owns authorship, taste, identity, relationships, consequential approval and final authority.
Broad TellMeN0TE operator/reconciliation branch across portfolio, external research, connected services, cross-domain reasoning, delegation and evidence reconciliation.
The N0TE product: persistent Artist/Song intelligence and reachable artist, studio, learning, A&R, release, audience, relationship and business jobs retained by canonical product scope.
Local execution role for DAW/project/files/audio/MIDI/plugins/hardware/OS and persistent workstation-side jobs when implemented and available.
layers.implementation_truth: Do not infer a specific daemon/process/module name from this role. Live repository and runtime evidence decide what local implementation actually exists.

layers.purpose: Canonical semantic memory and operational state owned by the appropriate Drive/repository/product/domain stores. It preserves shared meaning without granting universal access or authority.
One cloud-side coordination loop that observes, reconciles, deduplicates, routes, delegates, consumes receipts and writes back material state across legitimate executors.
layers.semantic_rule: One brain means one coordinated semantic state/claim graph, not one process, one agent, one executor or one blob.

layers.purpose: Deterministic checkpoint/delta/claim/executor-capability/routing/receipt/retry plumbing that reduces repeated CONTINUE reconstruction and tool-limit rediscovery.
Build, diagnose, test, red-team, repair and verify bounded N0TE construction increments. It exists to make N0TE correct, then becomes dormant or retires.
layers.retirement_rule: Construction machinery must shrink, become dormant or retire as accepted construction closes. New harness complexity requires an observed failure class, a bounded repair purpose, proof and a deletion/retirement condition.

scope_invariants: Foreground outcomes or one active bounded increment never replace the complete retained N0TE scope.
Semantic deduplication merges duplicate work expressions, never distinct accepted capabilities.
MAPPED, IMPLEMENTED, REACHABLE and GATE_B_ACCEPTED remain separate product states.
The external executor-capability assay describes execution surfaces only and must not become a second N0TE product-capability system.
The build harness may reference product requirements but may not redefine them.
Bare 'controller' terminology is ambiguous. Human-facing and machine-facing state should qualify CLOUD_COORDINATION_PLANE versus N0TE_BUILD_HARNESS.

required_review_lenses.rule: Review lenses are perspectives over one shared state, not permission to create permanent peer agents.
